payload.title: LERM Applied to ice cores
payload.description: This workflow applies the Linear Empirical Response Model (LERM) to ice core data over the Holocene, aiming to recreate Figure 5 from a referenced publication. The analysis involves loading data, applying LERM, and detecting transitions in climate data.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data analysis and visualization. Suppress warnings for presentation purposes.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Suppress Warnings

steps.description: Load ice core data using the pyLiPD library and prepare it for analysis.
steps.title: Load and Prepare Data

steps.description: Apply the Linear Empirical Response Model (LERM) to the ice core data to analyze climate transitions over the Holocene.
steps.title: Apply LERM to Ice Core Data

dependencies: Apply LERM to Ice Core Data
steps.description: Use specified parameters to detect transitions in the climate data.
steps.title: Detect Transitions in Climate Data

steps.description: Create visualizations to represent the detected transitions and recreate Figure 5 from the original publication.
steps.title: Visualize Results
